arguments.sql: SELECT c.user_id, SUM(t.amount_usd_cents) / 100.0 AS total_spent_usd FROM transactions t JOIN cards c ON t.card_id = c.id WHERE t.amount_usd_cents > 0 GROUP BY c.user_id ORDER BY SUM(t.amount_usd_cents) DESC, c.user_id ASC LIMIT 5
arguments.explanation: Lists the five users with the highest total spending across all their cards, with each user's id and total in dollars, highest first.
assumptions: Only positive transaction amounts count as spending. Negative amounts are left out because their meaning isn't documented.
Spending is the sum of transaction amounts over all of a user's cards for the whole data period (2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31).
All transactions are included, labelled or not, and with or without errors.
Users who spend the same amount are listed in order of user id.
